category_one_description: The School is seeking Internet service at its three locations. Bids should be provided for each level ofservice (Mbps) that can be provided at each location individually. One provider for all sites is preferred, but KIPP Tulsa reserves theright to award multiple bidders if necessary. The following are the minimum speeds needed for each site: 1Gbs at 1661 E. Virgin St.Tulsa OK 74106; 50 Mbps at 616 S. Main St., Suite 216, Tulsa OK 74119; and 1Gbs at 541 S. 43rd W Ave. Tulsa OK.
state_or_local_restrictions_1: KIPP Tulsa will consider multi-year and 1-year agreements with voluntary extension options. It is the intent of KIPP Tulsa toprocure goods or services that may be adjusted for the addition of new sites, relocation of sites, or adjustments to the quantity and/or capacity, in accordance with the terms of any resulting contract or service agreement. Companies submitting proposals musthave obtained a Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN) assigned by the Universal Service Administrative Company prior toproviding a proposal for this work. All bids must clearly show eligible and ineligible costs.
function: Internet Access and Data Transmission Service

category_two_description: Chelsea Public Library is seeking bids to replace end-of-life internal network infrastructure. The project includes one (1) 24-port PoE network switch, one (1) UPS/battery backup, fourteen (14) new network data drops, and two (2) wireless access points consisting of one indoor access point and one outdoor-rated access point to extend the library's network connectivity to the immediate exterior library property.For the Cabling service request, the quantity of 14 represents fourteen (14) network drops, not fourteen feet of cable. Bidders should determine the actual cable footage necessary to complete the 14 drops. Cabling should include all necessary eligible components, terminations, connectors, jacks/faceplates, patching, testing, labeling, and related installation.The project also includes relocation of the existing network rack as necessary to accommodate installation of the requested eligible network equipment. Bids should include installation, activation, initial configuration, and all eligible components and materials necessary for a complete and functional installation.Equivalent equipment that meets or exceeds the library's requirements will be considered. The library has no manufacturer preference.
state_or_local_restrictions_1: The Town of Chelsea generally requires three competitive bids when possible.
function: Switches and Necessary Software and Licenses
